text.arabic_uthmani: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

words.gloss_range: categorical negation opening the no-deity formula before the exception is admitted
words.prose: {{ar:لَآ}} ({{tr:lā}}) opens by clearing the whole deity class, not by denying one rival act. Because it governs the following indefinite deity noun inside the fixed negation-exception frame, the ayah begins with exclusion before lordship or life-death power is named. The long opening sound lets that clearing occupy audible space, and the boundary from 44:7 gives the certainty condition its content: if certainty is present, it is certainty in this exclusive declaration.

topics.headline: class negation before any title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first removes the whole field of rival deity-claims before presenting the one referent who remains.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:لَآ}} ({{tr:lā}}) as the opening of categorical negation over the indefinite deity noun, so the CRITICAL class-clearing claim is locally forced.

topics.headline: certainty receives exclusive content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 44:8 supplies the creed-content for the certainty condition left ringing at the close of 44:7.
topics.reason: The boundary row is coherent with the local syntax: the negative opening begins the creed that answers the preceding condition in 44:7, while the sound row supports the same opening pressure.

words.gloss_range: the indefinite deity or worshiped-authority class emptied by categorical negation before the exception
words.root_gloss_range: root range around worship, deification, ultimate reliance, and disputed affective attachment; locally the noun functions as the negated deity class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: categorical negation governing the deity noun
exception phrase that admits the sole referent

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَٰهَ}} ({{tr:ilāha}}) is singular in form but class-wide under {{ar:لَآ}} ({{tr:lā}}): one indefinite noun stands for any possible worshiped authority. Its existential predicate is compressed, so the formula spends no extra word on existence and keeps attention on the class being emptied before {{ar:إِلَّا هُوَ}} ({{tr:illā huwa}}) admits one survivor. The lexical field reaches worship, deification, dependence, and even the documented bewildered-attachment dispute, while local grammar keeps the active sense on the negated deity category. The repeated open-vowel negation-exception cadence makes the restriction land as one audible unit before the familiar formula is specialized by the following life-death predicates, with 2:255 as a relevant formulaic comparison where the same declaration is joined to the Living title.

topics.headline: singular noun empties the class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a singular-looking noun under categorical negation blocks both one rival deity and the whole class of possible rivals.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite and governed by {{ar:لَآ}} ({{tr:lā}}) in the exception construction, so the class-wide reading is grammatically licensed.

topics.headline: existence compressed into formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is compact: class term, negation, exception, and pronoun form one restriction mechanism rather than separate explanatory clauses.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence explicitly marks formulaic ellipsis in the negated existential predicate, supporting the CRITICAL compression claims.

topics.headline: worshiped authority, not a proper name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is negated is functional deification and ultimate allegiance, not merely a list of rival divine names.
topics.reason: The noun is a common deity term before the pronoun, so worshiped-authority pressure survives; the derivational dispute is kept as range pressure rather than allowed to replace the local deity-class sense.

topics.headline: exclusive formula becomes life-death proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the known exclusive formula is not left abstract; in 44:8 it is immediately interpreted through life-giving and death-causing power.
topics.reason: The local clause proceeds directly from the restriction formula into the coordinated predicates, and the comparison with 2:255 is retained as a formulaic echo rather than as control over the local parse.

topics.headline: cadence makes restriction audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the compact sound pattern helps the negation-exception mechanism land as one audible unit.
topics.reason: The sound row describes the local sequence itself and reinforces the same restriction mechanism established by grammar.

words.gloss_range: exception particle that turns categorical denial into exclusive affirmation
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hinge that reopens one slot after the deity class has been emptied. It does not begin a loose positive sentence; it completes the restriction and lets {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) stand as the sole survivor. That bridge also makes the certainty demanded in 44:7 concrete: conviction is filled by the one referent left after negation.

topics.headline: one slot reopened after denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the turn from emptied class to named identity happening inside one grammatical mechanism.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the exception construction as syntactically forced, so the particle's hinge role is not merely rhetorical.

topics.headline: certainty is filled by the survivor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that certainty from 44:7 is not abstract confidence but recognition of the sole referent produced by the restriction.
topics.reason: The boundary claim fits the local exception syntax: the pronoun after {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) supplies the one remaining referent.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun filling the exception slot and anchoring the following predicates

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first predicate governed by the pronoun
coordinated second predicate governed by the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) gives the exception visible form. Instead of letting verbal agreement alone carry the referent, the ayah places an independent pronoun after {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}), so identity is fixed before the actions begin. The same pronoun then hands the clause to {{ar:يُحْىِۦ}} ({{tr:yuḥyī}}) and {{ar:يُمِيتُ}} ({{tr:yumītu}}), while the boundary from 44:7 keeps it tied to the already active Lord frame and 44:9 will contrast this settled referent with continuing doubt.

topics.headline: visible survivor of restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sole referent is not merely implied; the pronoun makes the survivor of the negated class visible before any predicate follows.
topics.reason: QAC marks an independent pronoun in the exception slot, and attachment identifies it as the explicit exception from the negated deity class.

topics.headline: identity hands off to action proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the identity claim immediately becomes the subject-anchor for life-giving and death-causing.
topics.reason: The attachment table assigns {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) as subject of both coordinated Form IV verbs, preserving the CRITICAL handoff claim.

topics.headline: same Lord enters restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun carries the Lord frame from 44:7 into the restriction and then stands over against the doubt contrast in 44:9.
topics.reason: Attachment cross-reference evidence says the exception pronoun resumes the Lord frame from 44:6-7, while the next-ayah contrast is a coherent discourse observation.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect life-giving: caused life, with no overt object, paired with death-causing
words.root_gloss_range: root range around life, living, revival, remaining alive, flourishing, greeting, and other branches; locally Form IV selects causative life-bestowal and revival/vitality pressure
words.prose: {{ar:يُحْىِۦ}} ({{tr:yuḥyī}}) turns the exclusive identity into action proof. Form IV makes life caused and bestowed, while the omitted object keeps the field open rather than narrowing life-giving to one named recipient. The life-root range can suggest vitality, revival, preservation, and flourishing, but the local verb keeps that range focused on causative life-bestowal. Its immediate pairing with {{ar:يُمِيتُ}} ({{tr:yumītu}}) forms a recognized life-death sovereignty pair, comparable to the lordship proof in 2:258, and its first position follows the creaturely arc from entrance into life toward exit from it. The matched imperfect cadence turns the certainty condition from 44:7 into a balanced verbal proof beat.

topics.headline: unrestricted caused life
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that life-giving is presented as caused agency with an open scope, not as one isolated revival of a named object.
topics.reason: QAC and verb-instance evidence identify a Form IV imperfect with no overt direct object, exactly supporting the causative and open-scope claims.

topics.headline: vitality range focused by Form IV
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices life as more than bare biology, while the local form keeps that breadth directed toward making alive.
topics.reason: V4 lists many accepted branches for {{ar:ح ي ي}} ({{tr:ḥ-y-y}}), but the local Form IV verb selects causative life-bestowal; derivative breadth survives as lexical pressure, not as activation of every branch.

topics.headline: first pole of sovereignty merism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that life-giving is the first half of a paired proof of sovereignty over the whole living interval.
topics.reason: The local coordination places the two verbs side by side, and contextual collocation shows the Form IV life verb strongly paired with the Form IV death verb; the 2:258 comparison preserves the proof-frame echo.

topics.headline: life verb begins the proof beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from exclusive identity into a balanced verbal beat that makes certainty from 44:7 concrete.
topics.reason: The verb follows the pronoun directly and shares an imperfect pattern with the coordinated opposite, so the structural and cadence claims remain local.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction binding the life and death verbs as matched predicates
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the death verb a coordinated equal of the life verb. The second act is not an aftermath or separate topic; it is fused to the same subject and heard as the other pole of one proof-frame. Its brief hinge keeps the two longer imperfects balanced rather than collapsed.

topics.headline: matched life-death predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that life-giving and death-causing stand as equal coordinated acts under the same referent.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:يُمِيتُ}} ({{tr:yumītu}}) as coordinated with {{ar:يُحْىِۦ}} ({{tr:yuḥyī}}), preserving equality rather than subordination.

topics.headline: small hinge visibly joins the second verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the written and audible hinge makes the second verb feel joined to the first without erasing its separate force.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows describe the local proclitic attachment and sound hinge; neither is contradicted by the grammar.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect death-causing: caused mortality with no overt object, coordinated with life-giving
words.root_gloss_range: root range around death, lifelessness, cessation, deadening, stillness, and mortality; locally Form IV selects imposed death as the endpoint pole of the pair
words.prose: {{ar:يُمِيتُ}} ({{tr:yumītu}}) completes the power pair by making death an imposed act under the same subject. Like the life verb, it has no overt object, so mortality itself remains the open governed domain rather than one named victim. The root range of death, cessation, deadening, and lifelessness is narrowed here by Form IV into causing death. It closes the ordered merism begun by {{ar:يُحْىِۦ}} ({{tr:yuḥyī}}), contrasts with the reversed order in 53:44, and anticipates the same-surah death claims in 44:35 and 44:56. Its matched imperfect cadence gives the second pole a firmer audible close.

topics.headline: unrestricted caused death
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that death is presented as caused boundary-power, not as autonomous natural expiration or one local killing.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form IV imperfect and objectless in the attachment evidence, so causation and open scope are both preserved.

topics.headline: death range focused as imposed endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the broader mortality and deadening field, while the local form focuses it as the act of bringing life to its endpoint.
topics.reason: V4 accepts multiple {{ar:م و ت}} ({{tr:m-w-t}}) branches, but the local Form IV verb selects caused death, so other branches remain background pressure.

topics.headline: second pole closes the life-death span
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second verb seals a sovereignty span from life’s entrance to life’s exit.
topics.reason: The local coordination and high life-death collocation support the merism; the 53:44 and 2:258 comparisons are kept as formulaic contrasts and echoes.

topics.headline: death verb frames later claims
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this death-causing predicate prepares the surah’s later argument over first death and deathlessness in 44:35 and 44:56.
topics.reason: Same-surah death rows provide concrete references, and the cadence row describes the local matched imperfect pattern.

words.gloss_range: your Lord: a nominative relational title with second-person plural suffix after the life-death proof
words.root_gloss_range: root range around lordship, ownership, governing care, nurture, completion, and other branches; locally the divine title selects governing care and authority over the addressed group

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: exception pronoun to which the Lord title is tied

words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbukum}}) converts the cosmic proof into direct address. The suffix makes lordship definite and personal: the life-death agent is your Lord, not an abstract power. The title’s range joins ownership, governance, sustaining care, and development, while local syntax keeps it as a nominative predicate or apposition tied to {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}). Variant case readings move the title phrase differently, but preserve the same referent. The pressed central b-sound makes the short title carry that dense ownership, care, and authority pressure audibly. The phrase also continues the Lord thread from 44:6-7, anticipates the prayer-address in 44:12, and echoes the polemical title formula of 26:26.

topics.headline: suffix personalizes the title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices universal lordship landing on the addressed audience through the bound second-person plural suffix.
topics.reason: QAC marks the construct noun with an attached second-person plural suffix, and the cross-reference carries the Lord frame from 44:6-7.

topics.headline: governing care after life-death power
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that lordship names relational governance and nurture, not a bare honorific after the power verbs.
topics.reason: V4 gives many {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) branches, but the local divine title selects lordship, ownership, authority, and nurturing completion; unrelated branch images are not activated.

topics.headline: title identifies the proven actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that different case analyses adjust syntax without changing who the life-death actor is.
topics.reason: The local QAC parse is nominative apposition or predicate, while accepted case variants are retained as syntactic pressure that preserves the same lordship identity.

topics.headline: present lordship before ancestry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that present dependence is established before inherited authority enters the title chain.
topics.reason: The local sequence places {{ar:رَبُّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbukum}}) before the ancestral phrase, and the 26:26 echo supports a polemical lordship formula without overriding the local apposition.

topics.headline: cosmic Lord becomes direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from cosmic Lord in 44:6-7 to direct audience-dependence here and urgent address in 44:12.
topics.reason: The same-surah references and boundary rows are coherent with the attached suffix and the repeated Lord frame.

topics.headline: sound compresses title pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the short title carrying dense ownership, care, and authority pressure in its pressed sound.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local and reinforces the same title semantics retained in the lexical topic.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the present-audience Lord title to the ancestral Lord title
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) widens the title chain from present addressees to forefathers. It does not let the second lordship phrase drift away as a separate claim; it coordinates the two domains under one predicate-title frame. The short hinge also makes the repeated Lord title sound coordinated rather than merely stuttered.

topics.headline: present and ancestral domains joined
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices lordship expanding from the addressed present into inherited time through a connected title chain.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second Lord title as coordinated with {{ar:رَبُّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbukum}}), so the expansion across domains is local grammar.

topics.headline: proclitic hinge opens the second title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second title beginning with a visible and audible connector rather than arriving as an isolated repetition.
topics.reason: The written proclitic and sound hinge are local observations that support the coordinated title-chain payoff.

words.gloss_range: second repeated Lord title as the construct head governing the fathers phrase
words.root_gloss_range: root range around lordship, ownership, authority, nurture, and completion; locally the repeated title makes ancestors a directly governed domain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fathers phrase governed by the repeated Lord title

words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّ}} ({{tr:rabbu}}) repeats the Lord title instead of leaving the fathers to borrow it elliptically. As its own construct head, it governs {{ar:ءَابَآئِكُمُ}} ({{tr:ābāʾikumu}}), so ancestors are placed under lordship directly and not treated as an independent authority. Variant case readings keep both Lord titles moving together, preserving parallel title morphology. The repeated title also participates in the ancestral lordship formula echoed in 37:126 and gives the final beat a local refrain; its doubled b-sound audibly matches the present-audience title before ancestry is named.

topics.headline: fathers governed by repeated Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ancestors are not an add-on to the first title; they receive their own explicit grammatical subjection to Lordship.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the second title as the idāfa head governing the fathers phrase despite the bundle tag anomaly.

topics.headline: variants preserve title parallelism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant case movement changes syntactic analysis but keeps the two Lord titles parallel.
topics.reason: The canonical local parse is nominative, but accepted genitive and accusative variants validly show parallel phrase pressure without governing the canonical parse.

topics.headline: repetition absorbs ancestral prestige
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that repeated Lordship turns antiquity into a governed domain rather than rival warrant.
topics.reason: The 37:126 formulaic echo is concrete and compatible with the local repeated-title chain after deity-negation.

topics.headline: sound repeats title pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second compact title audibly matching the first before ancestry is named.
topics.reason: The sound row describes a local repetition and supports the same refrain payoff.

words.gloss_range: your fathers or forebears as a plural genitive complement under the repeated Lord title
words.root_gloss_range: root range around fatherhood, parents, forebears, source figures, and lineage; locally ancestry is acknowledged as inherited memory and subordinated under lordship

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct head governing the fathers phrase

words.prose: {{ar:ءَابَآئِكُمُ}} ({{tr:ābāʾikumu}}) brings the addressees' own inherited memory into the title chain. The plural construct with suffix makes the fathers both multiple and personally theirs, while the idāfa keeps them governed by the second {{ar:رَبُّ}} ({{tr:rabbu}}). The following agreeing adjective turns this personal ancestry into old ancestry, intensifying the inherited-authority problem. The kinship range can reach fathers, forebears, and source figures; the documented root dispute is useful only as contrast, because the local plural fathers are kinship authorities being subordinated, not a refusal-field. Their placement anticipates the ancestral challenge of 44:36 and reverses the inherited-precedent appeal seen in 2:170. The hamza catch inside the lineage word gives an audible interruption that matches the syntactic interruption of ancestral authority.

topics.headline: your forebears, not abstract ancestry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that inherited memory is made personal to the addressees through the suffix.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark a plural genitive noun with an attached second-person plural suffix.

topics.headline: ancestry placed under Lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fathers do not frame the Lord; the Lord title frames the fathers.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the fathers phrase the genitive complement of the repeated Lord title.

topics.headline: forebears as inherited authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word reaches communal lineage and source memory, while grammar keeps it in the kinship-ancestry field.
topics.reason: The local noun denotes fathers or forebears; the alternate refusal-field is retained only as a contrast because the syntax subordinates kinship authorities under lordship.

topics.headline: fathers paired with formerness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices ancestry becoming old ancestry through the following agreeing adjective.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following adjective as agreeing with the fathers phrase, and contextual evidence supports the fathers-formerness pairing.

topics.headline: ancestral precedent is reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fathers who could be invoked as precedent are first placed under divine Lordship.
topics.reason: The concrete comparisons with 2:170 and 44:36 are compatible with the local governed-ancestry construction.

topics.headline: sound catches inside lineage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an audible interruption inside the lineage word matching the syntactic interruption of ancestral authority.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local and remains subordinate to the syntactic point.

words.gloss_range: the former or earliest ones as a definite plural adjective qualifying the fathers
words.root_gloss_range: root range around firstness, formerness, priority, and tracing back to an origin; locally the adjective gives ancestral priority without granting authority
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ}} ({{tr:al-awwalīna}}) closes the ayah by making the fathers specifically the former ones. Its definite plural form presents a bounded body of recognized former fathers, with formerness distributed across generations rather than left as vague antiquity. Agreement and oblique adjective position keep chronological depth inside the fathers phrase, not as a new independent group. The root pressure of firstness and origin-tracing grants antiquity real weight, but the local construction denies that earlierness can outrank the Lord who governs those fathers. Its final position lands the ayah on ancestral time, echoing inherited-precedent fields such as 43:22 while enclosing them under the title chain. The long-vowel close stretches the final phrase into deep ancestral time and links the close back to 44:7.

topics.headline: formerness locked to fathers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word qualifies the fathers rather than adding a separate ancient group.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as a definite plural adjective agreeing with the fathers phrase.

topics.headline: earliestness without proof-status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that oldness deepens the scope of lordship without making ancestral priority a source of truth.
topics.reason: The local adjective supports formerness and firstness; origin-tracing pressure survives, but syntax keeps it subordinate to the governed fathers phrase.

topics.headline: bounded former generations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices not vague antiquity but a definite plural body of recognized former fathers.
topics.reason: The definite plural adjective form matches the plural fathers phrase and presents a bounded ancient group.

topics.headline: former-fathers field reweighted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that inherited-precedent language is echoed but reweighted so the old generations are ruled, not automatically followed.
topics.reason: The 43:22 comparison and former-fathers formula rows are concrete inter-ayah evidence; local grammar keeps the echo under the Lord-of-fathers construction.

topics.headline: ayah lands on ancestral time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah ending by enclosing the addressees' deepest inherited time inside exclusive lordship.
topics.reason: The final position of the adjective is local structure, and the boundary row coherently connects the certainty condition of 44:7 to inherited identity in 44:8.

topics.headline: long ending stretches ancestral depth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final cadence stretching the phrase into deep ancestral time and linking the close back to 44:7.
topics.reason: The cadence rows are local sound observations, and the 44:7 closure comparison is concrete.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لا إله إلا هو؛ يحيي ويميت؛ ربكم
baseline_models.mechanism: The exclusion of every worshipped claimant is immediately tested by opposed causatives and repeated lordship: deity status entails sole control of animation, deanimation, ownership, and care.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the worshipped supply the claimant class excluded by the opening negation.
Animate being supplies the positive pole whose life is actively produced.
Making strength die supplies the causative negative pole paired with vivification.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the relation established by control of both poles.
Repair, nurture, and completion keep lordship from collapsing into bare domination.

changed_reading.before: A creed is followed by two divine powers and a title.
changed_reading.after: The creed becomes an operational test: only the one who both animates and deanimates while owning and completing dependents can occupy the excluded category.

baseline_models.mechanism: Life as rain-fed growth, death as inert land, and both dominant and non-dominant nurture branches of رب make the pair a cultivation cycle extending through parental generations.

activation_trace.role: Earth revived by rain and growth supplies a material model of vivification.
Dead land and lifeless property supply the arrested state opposed to cultivation.
Stagewise repair and nurture supply the governing process between fertile and inert states.
The split-root image of nourishing and growing up sharpens lordship as cultivation rather than a static title.
Fatherhood and parental nurture extend the cultivation model across human generations.

changed_reading.before: Life and death mark only the entry and exit of organisms.
changed_reading.after: They can also name the Lord's staged management of fertility, growth, arrest, repair, and generational completion.

baseline_models.mechanism: Exact repetition of رب places the present audience and its earliest paternal source under one unmediated relation; chronology changes the dependents, not the Lord.

activation_trace.role: One image of lordship and ownership governs both repeated occurrences.
Fatherhood and nurture supply the vertical human relation crossed by the repeated Lord.
Beginning and precedence push the paternal line back to its earliest accessible head.

changed_reading.before: God is also the deity acknowledged by remote ancestors.
changed_reading.after: The repeated رب levels every generation beneath the same direct ownership, so ancestral priority cannot become an independent source of authority.

baseline_models.mechanism: The non-dominant ولي mapping of أول activates uninterrupted succession and kin-patronage: the first fathers become the opening links of a continuous dependent chain held beneath lasting lordship.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood supplies the genealogical links in the proposed chain.
Continuous succession turns firstness into the leading segment of an unbroken sequence.
Kinship and patronage supply the social bonds by which generations might claim support.
Staying and lasting supply the endurance of the one lordship across that succession.

changed_reading.before: The first ancestors are a remote chronological endpoint.
changed_reading.after: They may be heard as the first links of a continuous kin-patronage chain whose apparent continuity remains subordinate to one lasting Lord.

baseline_models.mechanism: Lexical branches allow life to be saving benefit and death to be a deadened heart or inert stillness, extending the opposed causatives from bodies to capacities for recognition and effective action.

activation_trace.role: Life as benefit or saving good supplies functional rather than merely biological vitality.
Deadness of heart supplies cognitive and affective deactivation.
Stillness and lifeless inactivity supply behavioral arrest.
Repair and completion provide a process by which useful agency can be restored.

changed_reading.before: The verbs report biological life and death alone.
changed_reading.after: They can coexist as claims that the Lord activates useful, receptive agency and can arrest hearts, understanding, or communal effectiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding chain fixes, delivers, differentiates, and makes precise each affair as mercy from the Lord; the focus pair then reads as outcomes administered through ordered dispatch rather than detached powers.

activation_trace.role: Saving benefit supplies one possible life-bearing outcome of administration.
Causative loss of strength supplies the opposed administered outcome.
Administration and completion anchor the dispatched affairs back in focus lordship.
A fixed inscription imposing judgment supplies durable specification before enactment.
Causing something to descend and arrive supplies delivery from specification into the receiving world.
Distinguishing one thing from another supplies differentiation of outcomes.
Affair and state supply the units subjected to differentiation.
Exactness and firm construction supply controlled rather than accidental execution.
Tender mercy supplies the stated orientation of the dispatch without erasing its death-bearing pole.

structural_cues: 44:2-6 moves from book to descent, differentiated affair, dispatch, mercy, and Lord immediately before 44:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed judgment, delivery, differentiation, exactness, and mercy; I supply the arrow that these are channels administering the focus verbs. A live alternative is that the sequence describes revelation alone while life and death remain a general proof.

changed_reading.before: He possesses a timeless generic ability to give life and death.
changed_reading.after: Life-giving and death-making are differentiated, timed, and delivered acts within one precise lordly administration whose declared orientation includes mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding Lord of sky, earth, and their interval is rescaled by the focus repetition into your Lord and the Lord of your first fathers; one relation nests cosmic space and genealogical time.

activation_trace.role: Repeated lordship supplies the invariant relation at the human and ancestral scale.
Beginning and precedence extend the relation backward along time.
Cosmic lordship supplies the larger frame repeated at the opening of the local scale.
Sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the upper spatial pole.
Earth as the lower counterpart supplies the lower spatial pole.
The connection standing between endpoints prevents the cosmic domain from becoming two disconnected extremes.
Stable knowledge without doubt marks recognition of the scale-spanning relation as the contested response.

structural_cues: 44:7 and 44:8 repeat رب in adjacent appositions while shifting from spatial totality to addressees and ancestry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic poles, their connective interval, and repeated lordship; I infer that the syntax deliberately scales one relation from cosmos to lineage. The live alternative is a pair of independent epithets without a nesting mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Your Lord and your ancestors' Lord is a family-directed claim.
changed_reading.after: The family line is a local cross-section of a lordship spanning upper, lower, intervening, present, and first domains.

context_deltas.mechanism: Doubt interpenetrates, play suspends purpose, smoke clouds and covers, the covering is briefly lifted, and conduct returns; this sequence turns useful life and heart-death into reversible activation states rather than only terminal events.

activation_trace.role: Life as saving benefit supplies restored useful agency rather than bare survival.
Deadness of heart supplies the obscured cognitive state.
Interpenetrating alternatives that block certainty supply internal cognitive entanglement.
Purposeless play supplies behavior detached from a stable end.
Black turbidity like smoke externalizes impaired distinction.
A covering that encompasses supplies collective deactivation rather than a private doubt.
Lifting a cover supplies temporary perceptual and practical reactivation.
Return after departure shows that the lifted state does not persist.

structural_cues: 44:9-15 forms a doubt/play, covering, plea, brief uncovering, and return sequence around the focus declaration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entanglement, purposelessness, covering, lifting, and return; I infer that crisis briefly reactivates recognition without producing durable life. The live alternative is a wholly physical punishment-and-reprieve sequence unrelated to the semantic range of the focus verbs.

changed_reading.before: Giving life and causing death are irreversible endpoint events.
changed_reading.after: They can also govern cycles in which understanding and useful agency are covered, briefly revived, and allowed to relapse, distinguishing temporary relief from durable vivification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to deliver God's servants, the prohibition on self-exaltation, refuge in my Lord and your Lord, and rescue from humiliating mastery turn exclusive deity and lordship into an anti-captivity claim.

activation_trace.role: Exclusive worship supplies the allegiance that coercive human mastery cannot rightfully absorb.
Lordship and ownership supply the contested relation over persons and generations.
Parental nurture supplies a generational relation distinct from Pharaoh-like coercion.
Performance of a right or trust makes release a due transfer rather than a favor from the captor.
Slavery and ownership expose the human control relation being challenged.
Self-exaltation and tyranny supply the counterfeit vertical claim over God and servants.
Seeking refuge supplies protective relocation under the true Lord.
My Lord and your Lord explicitly equalize opposing parties beneath one ownership.
Escape by separation supplies enacted release from the false mastery.
Humiliation through contempt characterizes the death-dealing regime from which life is restored.

structural_cues: 44:18-20 repeats servants of God, do not rise over God, and my Lord and your Lord before 44:30 narrates rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies duty, enslavement, tyrannical elevation, refuge, shared lordship, and separating rescue; I infer that 44:8 denies Pharaoh-like ownership and returns persons to divine lordship. A live alternative is that the narrative contrasts obedience without formulating emancipation as a reading of the focus verse.

changed_reading.before: Lord is a devotional title attached to cosmic life and death.
changed_reading.after: The title becomes politically disruptive: the sole giver of life owns and nurtures persons across generations, while coercive human mastery is a counterfeit that can be broken.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night movement and pursuit converge on one calm open sea-gap: it is a rescue route for one group and an engulfing trap for another, after which estates transfer. One prepared condition thus performs both focus verbs relationally.

activation_trace.role: Life as rescue from destruction supplies the saved group's outcome.
Loss of vitality and life supplies the pursuers' opposed outcome.
Night travel supplies the protected group's entry trajectory.
Catching up in pursuit supplies the opposing group's delayed entry trajectory.
A wide fissure supplies the shared spatial channel.
A broad open gap supplies the deliberately maintained affordance.
Drowning supplies the lethal closure of the same route for the pursuers.
Transfer of possession without contract extends the reversal from bodies to the living world's control.

structural_cues: 44:23-28 orders escape, pursuit, an intentionally open sea, drowning, abandoned abundance, and transfer to another people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two trajectories, one maintained opening, drowning, and transfer; I supply the causal arrow that the same affordance gives life to one relation and death to another. A live alternative treats rescue and drowning as two discrete acts rather than one bifurcating mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Giving life and causing death are two unrelated demonstrations of power.
changed_reading.after: A single controlled opening can enact both: route, timing, and relation turn the same condition into rescue for one group and death plus dispossession for another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later claim names our first death, denies reanimation, and demands the fathers. Repeated first-language makes the focus fathers test subjects in a reopenable life-death sequence rather than inert evidence from a sealed past.

activation_trace.role: A manner or single occurrence of death allows the focus causative to enter an ordinal sequence.
Fatherhood supplies the persons later demanded as proof.
Beginning and precedence mark the fathers as first rather than merely old.
The single death occurrence is explicitly called first, exposing the disputed ordinal structure.
Firstness supplies an opening position that the speakers try to treat as final.
Reviving the dead after death supplies the explicitly denied next phase.
The demanded fathers connect the abstract denial directly back to the focus ancestry.

structural_cues: 44:35-36 places first death, denial of revival, and bring our fathers in one challenge that echoes 44:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicitly first death, denied post-death revival, and demanded fathers; I infer that the focus's first fathers are jurisdictional test cases for return. A live alternative hears first as former earthly death without numerical implication.

changed_reading.before: The first fathers belong to a closed past, and life-to-death is a completed span.
changed_reading.after: First becomes ordinal pressure: death is an occurrence within a reopenable sequence, and the fathers are named precisely because their return would display the Lord's jurisdiction over that sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation is denied to be play, tied to truth, and directed to an appointed separation that gathers everyone. Life and death become phases in a morally discriminating process with a scheduled convergence.

activation_trace.role: Animate existence supplies the entrants into the measured process.
Loss of life supplies a phase that requires interpretation within the larger end.
Measure and proportion supply designed entry conditions rather than accidental existence.
Action without a valid end supplies the mechanism explicitly negated.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the lifecycle's governing reality.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the process's discriminating end.
An appointed time supplies scheduled convergence rather than indefinite drift.
Joining what was dispersed supplies convergence after separated lives and deaths.

structural_cues: 44:38-40 moves from non-play creation by truth to the appointed day of separation for everyone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, negated play, truth, timed judgment, and gathering; I infer a lifecycle pipeline linking the focus pair to that end. A live alternative is that the context asserts purpose broadly without specifying life and death as its phases.

changed_reading.before: The pair describes undirected biological turnover.
changed_reading.after: Vivification and death are calibrated stages in a purposeful, truth-governed arc that ends in timed gathering and discrimination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split ولي image initially lets first fathers evoke kin-patronage, but the later scene denies one patron any sufficiency or aid for another and leaves mercy as the exception. The context activates the branch by abrogating its independent force.

activation_trace.role: Kinship and manumission patronage supply the possible ancestral support network.
Fatherhood supplies the genealogy through which that support might be imagined to travel.
Repeated lordship supplies the direct relation left standing when patronage fails.
Sufficiency supplies exactly what one patron is denied for another.
The same kin-patronage image is instantiated twice and then made ineffective.
Aid and making another prevail supply the explicitly unavailable patronal function.
Tender mercy supplies the sole stated exception to failed horizontal support.

structural_cues: 44:41-42 contrasts failed patron-to-patron sufficiency and aid with the exception of divine mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared non-dominant mapped branch and an explicit failure of patronal aid; I infer pressure on ancestral mediation in 44:8. The materially live alternative is that no lexical echo between الأولين and مولى is intended because the mapped relation is form-distant.

changed_reading.before: The Lord presides over a lineage whose internal patronage might still mediate security.
changed_reading.after: Naming the fathers does not preserve their patronal power: every horizontal chain is disabled, leaving each generation directly dependent on the Lord's mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Secure dwelling, warded harm, no death except the first death, and favor from your Lord make the focus pair asymmetric: death is bounded while given life can be stabilized beyond further death.

activation_trace.role: Sparing alive supplies life preserved against a threatened killing.
Loss of vitality supplies the pole that will be explicitly bounded.
Placing oneself in protection supplies the defining posture of the secure group.
Settled security and trust supply the experiential form of stabilized life.
A single occurrence or manner of death supplies the death explicitly restricted to the first.
Firstness marks death as a bounded prior event rather than a recurring equal.
Warding off harm supplies active preservation from the death-adjacent punishment.
Gift and benefaction supply the non-earned source of this durable state.
Nurture and completion return the secure outcome to your Lord from the focus verse.
Attaining good and rescue names the completed asymmetrical outcome.

structural_cues: 44:51-57 progresses from secure station to exclusion of every death but the first, protection, and favor from your Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secure dwelling, explicit restriction of death, warding, favor, and completed rescue; I infer that life-giving can stabilize a state against the opposing verb. A live alternative limits the asymmetry to the depicted final community rather than the general force of 44:8.

changed_reading.before: Life and death are equal powers in indefinite alternation.
changed_reading.after: Their pairing is not ultimate symmetry: the Lord can confine death to a first occurrence and complete a protected life no longer vulnerable to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing statement makes the discourse easy in the addressee's language so that memory may reactivate. The compact focus confession can therefore function as a portable cognitive instrument that revives recognition and arrests inherited worship claims.

activation_trace.role: Worship and its object supply the allegiance that the mnemonic confession reorganizes.
Life as saving benefit supplies restored recognition as useful vitality.
Deadness of heart supplies the cognitive condition the discourse addresses.
Opening and ease after difficulty supply lowered resistance to reception and recall.
Language and speech supply the portable medium of activation.
Recovering what was forgotten supplies the intended cognitive transition.

structural_cues: 44:58 retrospectively characterizes the discourse as linguistically eased for remembrance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ease, language, and recovered memory; I infer that the compact confession in 44:8 participates in reanimating recognition. The live alternative is that 44:58 concerns the surah as a whole and does not privilege this particular clause.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse is only a proposition about divine identity and power.
changed_reading.after: It can also operate as an orally portable activation: repeated exclusive lordship revives recognition and lets inherited rival allegiances lose their grip.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because yielding is a distant موت branch and the causative direction is reader-supplied; it remains anchored in يميت, the packet's submission branch, contextual arrogance, and fixed truth. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory political-spiritual resonance, never as the direct lexical translation.

activation_trace.role: Submission to truth supplies a non-biological death image directly attached to the focus root.
Arrogant self-exaltation supplies the resistant posture that may be made to die.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies what resistant sovereignty is forced to yield to.

changed_reading.after: At the branch edge, He may also cause counterfeit sovereignty to die by forcing its self-exaltation to yield before truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because cosmic non-weeping is not a lexical gloss of death; it remains anchored in the focus death pole and in the packet's explicit post-destruction affective response from sky and earth. Render it as a possible social-cosmic consequence of death, not as a replacement for physical mortality.

activation_trace.role: Loss of vitality supplies the physical death from which relational erasure extends.
Grief expressed by tears and voice supplies the response explicitly withheld.
The overshadowing sky supplies one cosmic witness that does not mourn.
The lower earth supplies the other cosmic witness that withholds grief.

changed_reading.before: Death is the cessation of an organism.
changed_reading.after: Death may culminate in loss of relational witness as well: a regime can vanish without grief from either cosmic pole, leaving no honored claim on the world it occupied.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the verbal surface يحيي ordinarily targets life rather than naming a clan; it remains anchored through the packet's clan and sparing branches, the focus ancestry, and the context's group rescue, drowning, and transfer. Render it as a social-scale extension alongside, not instead of, individual life and death.

activation_trace.role: The clan or living kin-group supplies a collective bearer of life.
Sparing alive supplies preservation as one way a collective is kept in history.
Deathfall among people or property supplies collective dissolution rather than one body's end.
A people as a human collective supplies the historical unit put under trial.
A mutually supporting host supplies the collective that is dissolved.
Transfer of possession to another people supplies succession after collective death.

changed_reading.before: He gives and removes life one organism at a time.
changed_reading.after: He may also preserve, dissolve, and replace collective lives: clans and regimes remain alive through protection and inheritance, or die through the collapse of people, support, and estate.

strongest_changes: Life and death became precisely administered outcomes rather than detached attributes.
The maintained sea opening showed how one condition can rescue one relation and kill another.
First death, denied revival, and demanded fathers turned firstness into ordinal pressure on a supposedly closed past.
The non-dominant ولي mapping became productive when patron-to-patron aid was later disabled, removing ancestral mediation.
The secure ending bounded death to a first occurrence and made completed life asymmetrically durable.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated focus roots later returned in adversarial forms, while split mappings for رب to growth and أول to succession or patronage exposed mechanisms a conservative reading would miss. The result is not one synthesis but coexisting administrative, ecological, cognitive, emancipatory, genealogical, legal, and mnemonic readings.
remaining_uncertainties: How much interpretive weight the non-dominant رب and أول mappings should bear in downstream prose.
Whether the decree sequence specifically administers life and death or revelation more generally.
Whether the sea aperture is intentionally one bifurcating cause or two sequential wonders.
Whether cognitive, collective, and yielding-to-truth deaths are intended extensions or branch-level resonances.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Life and death as one nurturing jurisdiction.** `ح ي ي B006/B013` supplies sparing alive and life as saving benefit, `م و ت B001/B002` loss of life and making strength die, and `ر ب ب B001/B002` authority and nurture. The opposed verbs share one subject and are followed by doubled lordship; I infer that nurture includes control of both preservation and termination. The ayah resists treating death as evidence of absent care.
2. **Present lordship corrects ancestral delegation.** `ء ب و B001` supplies parental nurture and `ء و ل B001` beginning/precedence. The present audience and first ancestors are placed under the same repeated `رب`; I infer that parental transmission cannot become an independent source of authority. The ayah reads as a collapse of inherited religious distance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 44:35 and 44:56 make the life-death pair temporally decisive. The denial that the dead will be revived is later corrected by the protected group's experience of only the first death, sharpening lordship as authority over sequence, not just over mortal boundaries.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Life and death include activation and disabling.** `ح ي ي` `B006` is sparing alive and `B013` is life as saving benefit; `م و ت` `B002` is making strength die, `B006` deadness of heart, and `B012` still inactive lifelessness. The next ayah shows doubt expressed as play (`44:9`), followed by a covering affliction and a plea for removal (`44:10-12`). The polarity therefore governs capacity: enlivening enables saving response, while causing death can disable force and uptake. The packet supplies the behavioral and bodily sequence; I infer **epistemic inactivity -> exposure to disabling consequence**. The two verbs read beyond biological endpoints as control over operative vitality.

2. **Ancestral lordship carries the present across generations.** `ر ب ب` `B002` gives staged nurture, and `ء و ل` `B001` gives beginning and precedence. Repetition of `رَبُّ` binds the present addressees to prior fathers while the warning sequence presses toward a coming event (`44:10`). The pair assigns lordship continuity from origin to current crisis. The packet supplies the generational endpoints; I infer **continuous nurture from first generations -> present claim cannot be escaped as novel**. The ayah reads as continuity of governance, not an appeal to ancestry as authority.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The skeptics restrict reality to “our first death” in `44:35`, but the protected occupants pass that same first death without tasting another in `44:56`. This later exact echo made `يُحْىِى وَيُمِيتُ` the governing power over a bounded passage and its sequel, not only two opposed biological acts.

findings.text: Diriltme ve öldürme tek bir yetiştirici yetkinin içindedir; koruma, gücü devre dışı bırakma ve sona erdirme aynı yönetimin farklı işlemleridir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Legitimate lordship originates, shelters, develops, preserves, and can withdraw animate force.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Mercy's womb, the parent's formative care, rain-fed animation, and the removal of force materialize lordship as an intimate ecology of generation rather than title alone.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Nurture within generative shelter
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An owner-caretaker repairs and develops life within a merciful, womb-like shelter continuous with parental causation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ownership and lordship (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); gradual repair and nurture (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); merciful tenderness (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); womb as generative enclosure (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); fatherhood, upbringing, and generative causation (`quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The cluster gives custody a bodily and domestic mechanism. Rule becomes sustained repair and upbringing, while mercy supplies the enclosing womb in which life can be brought forth and maintained.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Legitimate lordship originates, shelters, develops, preserves, and can withdraw animate force.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Mercy's womb, the parent's formative care, rain-fed animation, and the removal of force materialize lordship as an intimate ecology of generation rather than title alone.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Animation between rainfall and cessation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Life rises through rain, vegetation, and animate force, is preserved from killing, and ends when that force is withdrawn.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: earth enlivened by rain and vegetation (`quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`); animate life (`quranic:root_000383:B003/m01`); preservation from killing (`quranic:root_000383:B006/m01`); loss of life and force (`quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`); removal or weakening of force (`quranic:root_001454:B002/m01`); first beginning (`quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 44:8 `يُحْىِ` (ح ي ي), `يُمِيتُ` (م و ت), `أَوَّلِينَ` (ء و ل).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Giving life expands into the revival of land and the preservation of living beings; causing death is its exact reversal, the withdrawal of force. The reference to firstness fixes both operations within an originating life cycle.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel adı Yaratıcıya özgü bir ad olarak tanımlar ve onu tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel adla köken bakımından ilişkilendirir. Aynı adın doğrudan seslenmede, yakarmada, ant bildiriminde ve parçaları düşürülmüş kalıplarda kullanıldığı birlikte gösterilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı ölümün karşıtı olan canlılık durumu etrafında kurar; canlı kalmayı, yaşamın farklı güç ve düzeylerini, yeniden canlandırmayı ve ölümün düşünülemediği sürekli var oluşu da bu çekirdeğe bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yaşam durumunu ve onu başlatma ya da sürdürme işlemini kapsar; yağmur, karşılama sözü, utanma ve başka özel türevler ayrı dallarda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel yaşam ve canlı olma anlamlarıyla, canlı kalma, canlandırma ve özel türevlerde beliren kullanımlar birbirinden ayrılarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Ölümün karşıtı olarak canlı olma ve canlı kalma durumudur; bir varlığı canlı kılma ya da yeniden canlandırma işlemini de kapsar. Bitkisel, duyusal ve düşünsel yaşam ile dünyadaki, sonraki ve ölmez var oluş bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın ölü olmayıp canlı bulunması ve yaşamını sürdürmesi temel anlamdır.
Canlı kılma veya ölümden sonra yeniden canlandırma, temel durumun ettirgen ve yenileyici uzantısıdır.
Bitkisel büyüme, duyum, düşünme, dünya yaşamı, sonraki yaşam ve ölmez var oluş, canlılığın kaynakta ayrılan özel düzeyleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ölüm karşıtı canlılık çekirdeğinde birleşir; toplu tanıklık ayrıca yaşamın güçlerini, sürekliliğini ve yeniden canlandırmayı bu çekirdeğin kapsamına alır.

error_profile.preserves: Ölüm karşıtı durumu, yaşamın sürmesini ve canlı kılma işlemini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yağmuru toprağı yaşatan neden olarak adlandırır ve bu anlamı verimli toprak, taze bitki, yağmura kavuşan topluluk ve otlanan hayvanlarla somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal insanın genel yaşamını değil, yağmurun toprağa, bitkiye ve geçime getirdiği canlılık ile buna bağlı kalıpları kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yağmur ve toprak canlılığına ilişkin temel adlandırma, toprağı verimli bulma ve bir topluluğun yağmurla ota kavuşması gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımlardan ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Yağmurun toprağı canlandırması, verim ve taze bitki meydana getirmesidir; yağmurun kendisi de bu yaşatıcı etkiden ötürü adlandırılır. Toprağı bu durumda bulmak ve bir topluluğun yağmurla bol ota kavuşması yapıya bağlı uzantılardır.

facets.statement: Yağmur, toprağa canlılık verdiği ve onu ölüm görünümünden çıkardığı için bu adla anılır.
Verimli toprak ile taze ve hareketli bitki, yağmurun yaşatıcı etkisinin görünür sonuçlarıdır.
Toprağı verimli bulmak veya bir topluluğun yağmur ve bol ota kavuşması yalnız belirli yapılarda anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yağmurun toprağı canlandırdığı konusunda birleşir; verim, taze bitki ve hayvanların otla güçlenmesi bu etkinin sonuçları olarak aktarılır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ana okuma canlı varlıktır; bitmeyen gerçek yaşam kaynakta bulunan ayrı bir anlam değişkesi olarak tutulur, genel yaşam durumu ise B001'e bırakılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel biçimin canlı varlık anlamı tanımın merkezidir; aynı biçimin bitmeyen yaşam okuması bağımsız bir kaynak değişkesi olarak ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Ruh, duyum veya canlılık taşıyan varlığı anlatır ve ölü cansız varlığın karşısında durur. Aynı biçim kaynakta ayrıca bitmeyen gerçek yaşam için kullanıldığından bu ikinci okuma ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel yılan adı çekirdekte tutulur; erkek yılan, yılan bakıcısı ve yılanlı yer gibi özel biçimler yalnız kendi sözcük sınırlarında yorumlanır.

concept_map.definition: Erkek veya dişi olabilen yılan için kullanılan genel addır; erkek yılan için ayrıca özel bir adlandırma bulunur. Adın yaşam düşüncesinden türediği açıklaması, sarılma düşüncesine dayanan karşı açıklamayla birlikte ve kesinleştirilmeden verilmelidir.

facets.statement: Genel yılan adı hem erkek hem dişi birey için kullanılabilir.

Yılan adının yaşamdan türetilmesi ile sarılıp kıvrılmadan türetilmesi birbirine rakip iki açıklamadır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi utanmayı yüzsüzlüğün karşıtı olarak verir ve kişinin kötü görülen davranışlardan içsel bir daralma nedeniyle kaçınmasını temel anlam sayar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal içsel utanma ve kötüden çekinmeyle sınırlıdır; öldürmeyip sağ bırakma anlamındaki benzer biçim bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel utanma adı ile bir kişiden veya davranıştan utanmayı bildiren yapılar ayrı dil bilgisel gerçekleşmeler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kötü, uygunsuz veya yüz kızartıcı gördüğü şey karşısında içten daralması ve bu nedenle ondan kaçınmasıdır; yüzsüzlüğün karşıtı olarak değerlendirilir.

facets.statement: Kötü görülen şey karşısında duyulan içsel daralma ve utanma temel duygudur.
Bu duygu kişiyi kötü davranışı bırakmaya veya ondan uzak durmaya yöneltir.
Bir kişiden veya onun karşısında yapılan bir şeyden utanma, duygunun katılımcısı belirtilmiş kullanım biçimidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar utanmayı yüzsüzlüğün karşıtı, kötü davranış karşısındaki içsel daralma ve o davranışı bırakmaya yönelten duygu olarak birlikte tanımlar.

error_profile.preserves: İçsel utanmayı, kötüyle ilişkisini ve çekinme sonucunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çoğunluğu kadınları veya gençleri sağ bırakıp öldürmemeyi açıkça destekler. Buna karşılık toplu aktarımdaki bir parça bunun tersini söyleyen eksik ya da bozuk bir olumsuzluk içerdiğinden dal ancak bu metinsel karşıtlık belirtilerek kabul edilebilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım öldürmeyip sağ bırakma okumasını izler; karşıt yöndeki tek olumsuz aktarım kaynak içi uyuşmazlık olarak korunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız belirli kişileri sağ bırakmayı bildiren türemiş yapıdadır; temel biçime genel bir utanma veya yaşam anlamı olarak taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kadınları, gençleri veya başka belirli kişileri öldürmeyip sağ bırakmaktır. Kaynakların baskın açıklaması bu yöndedir; tek bir karşıt olumsuz aktarım tanımın parçası değil, metinsel uyuşmazlıktır.

facets.statement: Öldürme imkânı veya tehdidi altında bulunan kişileri öldürmeyip canlı bırakmak temel işlemdir.
Kadınlar ve bir topluluğun gençleri kaynakta açıkça belirtilen kişi gruplarıdır.
Toplu aktarımın bir bölümündeki karşıt olumsuzluk, baskın sağ bırakma açıklamasıyla uyuşmayan metinsel bir değişkedir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana çizgisi insanlar arasında esenlik, yaşam ve kalıcılık dileği taşıyan karşılama sözüdür. Aynı ifade içinde egemenlik yorumu da geçtiği için bu yorum çekirdeğe katılmamalı, ayrı bir kaynak değişkesi ve B008 ile kesişen okuma olarak gösterilmelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel karşılama adı, yaşam ve esenlik dileyen kalıp ile bütün kalıcılığı yüce varlığa ayıran söz ayrı kullanımlar olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların birbirine esenlik, yaşam ve kalıcılık dilediği karşılama veya karşılık verme sözüdür. Bazı aktarımlarda aynı kalıp egemenlik bildirimi olarak yorumlandığından bu okuma ana anlamdan ayrı tutulur.

İnsanların birbirini karşılaması ve esenlik sözünü karşılıklı iletmesi bu çekirdeğin toplumsal kullanımıdır.
Aynı sözün egemenlik bildirdiği yorumu, esenlik dileğinden ayrılması gereken bir kaynak değişkesidir.
